title: 11 years ago I wanted to make a game where you’re a fly. I’m finally making it.
author: erthenix
selftext:
Hi everyone, 

I first had this idea in high school and told my friends about it. They laughed at the idea of a game where you just play as a fly in someone’s house.

I never really let go of it, and now it’s becoming an actual game.

It’s called FlyHub. You fly around the house, find food, land on furniture or the ceiling, and try to stay out of reach of the human who wants you gone. You improve, unlock new kinds of flies like mosquito and hover fly with different skill sets and gameplay mechanics.

There’s also a cat, which looks a lot bigger from down there. I use my cat as the model and use his own voice for the sound effects.

This is footage from the current build. It’s still early and there’s plenty to work on, but it feels strange to finally have something to show from an idea I was talking about back at school.

Tell me what you think!

comments.author: erthenix
